description: Golden cases for the KISS preview cache path contract (#2017/#1997): given an asset's directory (relative to its library root) and filename (including extension), every producer/consumer — server (fs/xmp.ts:cachePathForAsset/cachePathFor), web (maple-cache.service.ts:previewCachePath), and Apple (MapleSidecarPaths.previewURL) — must resolve the SAME `<relDir>/.maple/previews/<filename>.avif` path relative to the library root / asset's own folder. `relPath` is that path relative to the library root (POSIX separators). One physical copy of this file is duplicated per platform's test/resource tooling (same convention as auth-contract.json) — see src/api/tests/fixtures/, src/web/projects/maple-common/src/lib/state/, and src/apple/Packages/MapleCore/Tests/MapleCoreTests/Fixtures/.
